title: True Short Esophagus in Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease
brief_summary: True short esophagus is controversial in surgery for gastroesophageal reflux disease and hiatus hernia. Recently, it was published that extensive esophageal mobilization achieved an esophageal length adequate to perform around the esophagus fundoplication in all cases with satisfactory long-term results.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients submitted to primary minimally invasive surgery for gastroesophageal reflux diseases or hiatus hernia.
* Age \> 18 years.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients already submitted to minimally invasive surgery for gastroesophageal reflux diseases or hiatus hernia for recurrence of the disease.
* Patients submitted to open surgery for gastroesophageal reflux diseases or hiatus hernia.
* Patients affected by other esophageal diseases.
* Age \< 18 years.
study_population: Patients affected by gastroesophageal reflux disease or hiatus hernia submitted to primary minimally invasive surgery.
